x-e-e1-01.title: Fumana izenzo ezingahambelani nesaziso sechibi
x-e-e1-01.topic: Imibuliso emifutshane, izaziso, nemifanekiso ezotywe ngamagama
x-e-e1-01.goal: Hambelanisa imithetho emithathu esesazisweni nemeko yomntu ngamnye, ukhethe iimeko ezophula imithetho, uze uthi isizathu ngesiNgesi.
x-e-e1-01.material:
Isaziso emnyango wechibi (sibhalwe ngamagama kuphela, akukho mfanekiso):

Pool Rules
1. No running.
2. Swim caps on, please.
3. Under 8? Come with a grown-up.

(grown-up = an adult)

Abantu abane baya echibini.
UMina uneminyaka eyi-7. Uza noMama wakhe, kwaye unekepusi.
UJun uneminyaka eyi-10. Uza yedwa, kwaye akanayo ikepusi.
UTom uneminyaka eyi-6. Uza nomntakwabo. Umntakwabo uneminyaka eyi-9. UTom unekepusi.
USue uneminyaka eyi-11. Ukhwela ngeenyawo esiya echibini yedwa, kwaye unekepusi.
x-e-e1-01.prereq.0: Amanani esiNgesi ukusuka ku-1 ukuya ku-11
x-e-e1-01.prereq.1: Izimelabizo ezilula ezinjenge I, you, he, she
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha bonke abantu abaphula imithetho esesazisweni.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.hint.0: Yenza itheyibhile enobudala bomntu ngamnye, ngubani amphelekileyo, nekepusi, omnye ngomnye.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.hint.1: Fumana ukuba ulwazi luni umthetho ngamnye ohambelana nalo, uze uludibanise ngemigca.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.r.a: Hlola ukuba ihambelanise ubudala bukaMina nokuba ungubani amphelekileyo nomthetho 3.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.r.c: Cinga ukuba umntu oze noTom ngumntu ofanayo nomntu othethwa ngumthetho.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.r.d: Hambelanisa ubudala bukaSue nendlela ahamba ngayo nemithetho 1 no-3 ngokwahlukeneyo.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.explain: UJun akanayo ikepusi, ngoko uphula umthetho 2. UTom uphantsi kwe-8, kodwa umntakwabo oze naye uneminyaka eyi-9, ngoko akangomntu 'omdala', kwaye uTom uphula umthetho 3. UMina weza noMama wakhe, kwaye uSue uneminyaka eyi-11, ngoko kulungile ukuba ahambe aze yedwa.
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.prompt: Xelela umntakwabo kaTom kwisivakalisi esinye okanye ezimbini zesiNgesi. Dibanisa nomthetho isizathu sokuba uTom engakwazi ukungena echibini ngoku.
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.hint.0: Qala uthelekise ubudala bukaTom nenani elikumthetho 3.
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.hint.1: Qala nge 'Tom is under 8, so ...' uze ubhale okufunekayo emva koko.
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba udibanise isizathu sokuba uTom engakwazi ukungena nomthetho (under 8)?
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uthethe ukuba kutheni umntakwabo engeyena umntu omdala?
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingaba izivakalisi zakho zesiNgesi zimfutshane kwaye ziyaqondakala lula?

x-e-e1-02.topic: Imibuliso emifutshane, izaziso, nemifanekiso ezotywe ngamagama
x-e-e1-02.title: Lungisa umgca ongalunganga kwisaziso sezinto ezilahlekileyo esikhutshiweyo
x-e-e1-02.goal: Thelekisa isaziso sezinto ezilahlekileyo nomyalezo umhlobo awukopishe kuso, umgca ngomgca, ufumane umgca ongalunganga, uze uwubhale kwakhona ngokuchanekileyo.
x-e-e1-02.material:
Isaziso kwibhodi yeendaba yesikolo (sibhalwe ngamagama kuphela):

Lost and Found
Found: a blue water bottle, near Room 3.
Ask Ms. Park in Room 1 after school.

Umhlobo wakho uJia wabona esi saziso kuba ebekhangela ibhotile yakhe yamanzi, wathumela umyalezo kuHana. UHana ufuna ukuyithelekisa nesaziso.
x-e-e1-02.prereq.1: Ukufunda amanani amagumbi anjengo Room 1, Room 3
x-e-e1-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca omnye kumyalezo kaJia owahlukileyo kwisaziso.
x-e-e1-02.s.s1.hint.0: Khomisa amagama akwisaziso (umbala, inani legumbi, igama lomntu) omnye ngomnye uze uwahambelanise nemigca yomyalezo.
x-e-e1-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kumgca ngamnye womyalezo, uhambelanise nomgca wesaziso okopishe kuwo, uze ukhangele igama elingahambelaniyo.
x-e-e1-02.s.s1.explain: Umgca 4 awuchanekanga. Kwisaziso, uMs. Park useGumbini 1, kodwa umyalezo uthi Igumbi 3, ngoko akuchanekanga. I-blue kumgca 2 ifana nesaziso, kwaye iRoom 3 kumgca 3 yindawo ibhotile eyafunyanwa kuyo, ngoko ichanekile.
x-e-e1-02.s.s2.prompt: Lungisa umgca ongalunganga owufumeneyo ngoku ukuze uhambelane nesaziso, uze uwubhale ngesiNgesi.
x-e-e1-02.s.s2.hint.0: Phinda ufunde umgca wesaziso oqala nge-'Ask'.
x-e-e1-02.s.s2.hint.1: Kukho igama elinye kuphela lokutshintsha kwisivakalisi sokuqala. Fumana apho ligama elo likhona.
x-e-e1-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba uhlolile kwisaziso inani legumbi apho uMs. Park ekhona?
x-e-e1-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba wahlule indawo ibhotile eyafunyanwa kuyo (Igumbi 3) nendawo yokubuza (Igumbi 1)?

x-e-e1-03.topic: Imibuliso emifutshane, izaziso, nemifanekiso ezotywe ngamagama
x-e-e1-03.title: Yenza isaziso semigca emibini sokuhlala emnyango wegumbi lokufundela
x-e-e1-03.goal: Gweba ukuba loluphi ulwazi (phi, nini) umfundi wesaziso alufunayo, khetha isaziso esifanelekileyo, uze wenze isaziso sakho semigca emibini.
x-e-e1-03.material: Abafundi beKlasi 3 basegumbini lomculo ukusuka ngo-10:00 ukuya ku-11:00 namhlanje. Bafuna ukuhlala isaziso emnyango wegumbi lokufundela. Undwendwe oza kwiklasi yeKlasi 3 ngo-10:30 uya kufunda esi saziso.
x-e-e1-03.prereq.0: Amagama alula anjengo music room, today
x-e-e1-03.s.s1.prompt: Khetha isaziso esivumela undwendwe oza ngo-10:30 ukuba lazi 'apho kufuneka aye khona' kunye 'nokuba kufuneka alinde kangakanani'.
x-e-e1-03.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ubhale imibuzo emibini undwendwe angafuna ukuyibuza.
x-e-e1-03.s.s1.hint.1: Phawula omnye ngomnye ukuba isaziso ngasinye siyayiphendula le mibuzo mibini.
x-e-e1-03.s.s1.r.b: Cinga ukuba ungazi ukuba 'later' ilide kangakanani.
x-e-e1-03.s.s1.r.c: Hlola ukuba esi saziso sithi zombini izinto undwendwe azifunayo.
x-e-e1-03.s.s1.r.d: Hlola ukuba sinexesha lokuqala kuphela, okanye nexesha lokugqiba.
x-e-e1-03.s.s1.explain: c ixela zombini indawo (igumbi lomculo) nexesha lokugqiba (11:00). Kwi-a indawo ilahlekile, kwi-b ixesha elide lilahlekile, kwaye kwi-d ixesha lokugqiba lilahlekile.
x-e-e1-03.s.s2.prompt: Bhala isaziso ngesiNgesi, semigca emibini, sokuhlala emnyango wegumbi lokufundela leKlasi 3. Kufuneka siquke indawo nexesha ukuya kutsho nini.
x-e-e1-03.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ubhale igama elinye nganye lokuphi, nini, nokuba ngubani.
x-e-e1-03.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala 'phi' kumgca wokuqala kunye 'nini' kumgca wesibini, emva koko uphinde ujonge.
x-e-e1-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba umntu odlulayo angafunda athi phi, nokuba kuya kutsho nini?
x-e-e1-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ufake ulwazi olufunekayo kuphela kwimigca emibini?
x-e-e1-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingaba ukhethe ulwazi oluthile ongathanda ukulongeza (umz., Class 3, Please wait)? (Akunyanzelekanga)

x-e-e1-04.title: Ngubani ithetha? Ukutshintsha ingcinga yakho njengoko amacebiso andisa
x-e-e1-04.topic: Amacebiso ngokuba ngubani, yintoni, kwaye phi
x-e-e1-04.goal: Rhoqo xa umgca wentetho wongeza icebiso, gweba kwakhona ukuba ngubani ithetha, uze ucacise icebiso eliqinisekisayo ngesiNgesi.
x-e-e1-04.material: Uza kubona imigca umntu ayithethayo, umgca omnye ngexesha. Landela amacebiso uze ucinge ukuba ngubani ithetha.
x-e-e1-04.thinking.0: Gcina iindlela ezininzi ezinokwenzeka zivulekile kwicebiso elinye
x-e-e1-04.thinking.1: Phinda ujonge isigwebo sakho ngecebiso elitsha
x-e-e1-04.prereq.0: Amagama alula anjengo book, card, week
x-e-e1-04.prereq.1: Imibuliso enjengo Welcome, Can I help you?
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.prompt: Imigca iphuma umgca ngomgca. Rhoqo, khetha bonke abantu abangaba ngabathethi.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.hint.0: Phakathi kwabantu obashiye kwinyathelo elidlulileyo, hlola kuphela kwakhona ukuba bayahambelana nomgca omtsha.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.hint.1: Kumgca omtsha, fumana amagama ayibiza 'into' okanye 'ixesha'.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ujonga lo mgca omnye kuphela, ngubani onokuba ngumthethi?
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Ukusuka kumgca wokuqala wodwa, abantu abaninzi banokwenzeka, njengomsebenzi wevenkile okanye umlondolozi wethala leencwadi.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Abantu bakwiivenkile nabo banika lo mbuliso.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Cinga ukuba lo mbuliso uhlala usetyenziswa kwibhasi.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Abantu bakumathala eencwadi nabo babuza amagama anikela uncedo.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Abantu bakwiivenkile ezithengisa iincwadi nabo banika umbuliso ofanayo.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Iincwadi zivele, ngoko umsebenzi wevenkile yempahla nomqhubi webhasi bawile. Umlondolozi wethala leencwadi nomsebenzi wevenkile yeencwadi basala.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ukudibanisa yonke imigca emithathu, ngubani ohambelana kakhulu?
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Ekubeni ithetha icela ukubona ikhadi kwaye ithi unokugcina incwadi iiveki ezi-2, kuyenzeka kakhulu ukuba ngumlondolozi wethala leencwadi obolekayo iincwadi. Evenkileni yeencwadi, xa uthenga incwadi ngokuqhelekileyo akukho xesha.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Cinga ukuba 'iiveki ezi-2' kunye 'nekhadi' zingathetha ntoni evenkileni yeencwadi.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Cinga ukuba amagama ikhadi kunye neeveki ezi-2 enza ntoni.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.reflect: Ukuba uzinze kumntu omnye kumgca wokuqala kuphela, jonga umva ukuba ingcinga yakho itshintshe njani njengoko kuvela amacebiso amatsha. Iindlela ezinokwenzeka zancipha ngecebiso ngalinye.
x-e-e1-04.s.s2.prompt: Bhala ngesiNgesi icebiso elinye kumgca wokugqibela elikwenza ucinge 'umlondolozi wethala leencwadi' kunokuba 'ngumsebenzi wevenkile yeencwadi'.
x-e-e1-04.s.s2.hint.0: Kumgca wokugqibela, fumana igama elisetyenziswa ngokwahlukileyo evenkileni yeencwadi nakwithala leencwadi.
x-e-e1-04.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala isivakalisi esinye ngendlela: '__ ithetha ~, ngoko ...'.
x-e-e1-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba uthethe ukuba icebiso olikhethileyo lahlula ngenene ivenkile yeencwadi kwithala leencwadi?
x-e-e1-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ucacise ukuba 'ikhadi' okanye 'iiveki ezi-2' ziyenza ntoni?

x-e-e1-05.topic: Amacebiso ngokuba ngubani, yintoni, kwaye phi
x-e-e1-05.title: Isinema okanye isikhululo setreyini? Ukuthelekisa amandla amacebiso
x-e-e1-05.goal: Thelekisa ukuba amacebiso akwingxoxo agqiba kangakanani indawo, uze ucacise ngesiNgesi ukuba kutheni amacebiso abuthathaka kuphela engonelanga.
x-e-e1-05.material:
Abantu ababini bathetha ngolu hlobo.
A: Two tickets, please.
B: Which film?
A: The 3 o'clock one.
B: Row F or Row G?
A: Row F, please.

(Row = a line of seats, film = a movie)

Umhlobo wakho uYuna uthi, "Tickets! It's a train station." Umhlobo wakho uMin uthi, "It's a cinema (a movie theater)."
x-e-e1-05.thinking.1: Yazi ukuba icebiso elinye lingahambelana neendawo ezininzi
x-e-e1-05.prereq.0: Amagama alula anjengo ticket, film, seat
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.prompt: Khetha onke amacebiso axhasa isitatimenti sikaMin ('cinema') ngamandla kakhulu.
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.hint.0: Vavanya icebiso ngalinye nge-'Ingaba lingasetyenziswa nakwezinye iindawo?'
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuthi amagama afanayo kwisikhululo setreyini okanye kwigadi yezilwanyana.
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.r.a: Cinga ukuba isinema yeyona ndawo kuphela efuna ithikithi.
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.r.b: Cinga ukuba igama film lelikwindawo ephi.
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.r.c: Cinga ukuba isinema yeyona ndawo kuphela apho kuvela amaxesha.
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.r.d: Cinga ukuba umqolo nonobumba bagqiba ntoni.
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.explain: Film (imuvi) kunye neRow F/G (umgca wezihlalo) amacebiso aqinileyo akhomisa kwisinema. Ticket kunye ne3 o'clock amacebiso abuthathaka anokusetyenziswa nakwisikhululo setreyini, kwigadi yezilwanyana, okanye kwiholo lekhonsathi.
x-e-e1-05.s.s2.prompt: Phendula uYuna ngesiNgesi ngesivakalisi esinye okanye ezimbini. Bhala ukuba kutheni 'tickets' yodwa ingenakugqiba ukuba sisikhululo setreyini.
x-e-e1-05.s.s2.hint.0: Cinga iindawo ezimbini okanye ezintathu ezisebenzisa 'ticket'.
x-e-e1-05.s.s2.hint.1: Zama ukuqala ngendlela 'Tickets can be for ... too.'
x-e-e1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba uchaze ubuncinane enye indawo apho amathikithi asetyenziswa khona?
x-e-e1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ukhankanye amacebiso akhomisa kwisinema (film, Row)?

x-e-e1-06.topic: Amacebiso ngokuba ngubani, yintoni, kwaye phi
x-e-e1-06.title: Into engaziwayo: sibuze ntoni emva koko?

Umhlobo ucinga ngento. Kukho amacebiso amabini.
Hint 1: It is round. (It is round and roundish)
Hint 2: It is in the kitchen. (It is in the kitchen)

Kukho abagqatswa abane: apple, plate, clock, kunye cup. Ufuna ukufumana enye ngokubuza imibuzo ye-yes/no.
x-e-e1-06.prereq.0: Iindlela zemibuzo ezinjenge Is it ...? Can you ...?

x-e-e1-06.s.s2.prompt: Usebenzisa umbuzo owahlukileyo kowo ukhethe ngaphambili, bhala umbuzo omnye wesiNgesi onokuncitshisa abagqatswa, uze wongeze ngesiNgesi ukuba ngowuphi ogqatswa osalayo ukuba impendulo ithi "yes."
x-e-e1-06.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala umgca wempawu nganye yabagqatswa abane (kuyatyiwa, kuxela ixesha, kubamba izinto).
x-e-e1-06.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha impawu ethi 'yes' kwenye kuphela uze uyiguqule ibe ngumbuzo.

x-e-e1-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba abagqatswa abasalayo bahlukile kwi-'yes' nakwi-'no'?

x-e-e1-07.title: Fumana uze ulungise impendulo engahambelani kwingxoxo yomhla wokuzalwa
x-e-e1-07.goal: Usebenzisa imeko (ngumhla wokuzalwa kabani), fumana impendulo engahambelani kwingxoxo, uze ukhethe impendulo ehambelanayo.
x-e-e1-07.material: Namhlanje ngumhla wokuzalwa ka-Ana. Ayingomhla wokuzalwa ka-Leo. U-Leo unika u-Ana isipho.
x-e-e1-07.prereq.0: Amabinzana Happy birthday, Thank you, You're welcome
x-e-e1-07.s.s1.prompt: Kule ngxoxo, khetha umgca apho impendulo ka-Ana ingahambelani nemeko.
x-e-e1-07.s.s1.hint.0: Qala uhlole ukuba namhlanje ngumhla wokuzalwa kabani, emva koko ufunde impendulo nganye kwezimbini zika-Ana kunye noko u-Leo wakuthethayo kanye phambi kwayo.
x-e-e1-07.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola, umgca omnye ngexesha, ukuba umgca ngamnye unokufundwa njengempendulo yemvelo kumgca ongaphambili kanye.
x-e-e1-07.s.s1.explain: Umgca 2 awuhambelani. Namhlanje ngumhla wokuzalwa ka-Ana, hayi ka-Leo, ngoko "to you too" ayihambelani. U-Ana, owamkele isipho, kufuneka athi enkosi, kwaye emva koko iyadibana nelithi "You're welcome." lika-Leo kumgca olandelayo.
x-e-e1-07.s.s2.prompt: Khetha impendulo echanekileyo ka-Ana kumgca owufumeneyo ngoku.
x-e-e1-07.s.s2.hint.0: Qala uguqulele amagama kwisiKorea ukubona ukuba asetyenziswa kwimeko enjani.
x-e-e1-07.s.s2.hint.1: Faka ukhetho kumgca 2 uze ufunde ukuba luyadibana namazwi ka-Leo kumgca wokugqibela.
x-e-e1-07.s.s2.r.a: La mazwi aphendula umbulelo. Ngubani ekufuneka ambulele ngoku?
x-e-e1-07.s.s2.r.b: Hlola ukuba "me too" iyahambelana noko u-Leo wakuthethayo.
x-e-e1-07.s.s2.r.c: Cinga ukuba ingaba le yimpendulo ehambelanayo xa ufumana isipho.
x-e-e1-07.s.s2.r.d: Cinga ukuba ngubani owenze ntoni kubani kumzuzu ophiweyo isipho.
x-e-e1-07.s.s2.explain: Ekubeni efumene isipho, Thank you iyahambelana. Ngolu lungiso, "You're welcome." ka-Leo kumgca olandelayo nayo ilandela ngokwemvelo.
